Flat owners can apply for the HDB EIP Buyback Assistance Scheme if they have made regular genuine attempts over a continuous period to sell their flat at a reasonable asking price while constrained by one or more Ethnic Integration Policy (EIP) limits, and face genuine difficulties selling their flats at a reasonable price.

- Flat owners must have made regular genuine attempts over a continuous period to sell the flat at a reasonable asking price while constrained by one or more EIP limits ([https://www.hdb.gov.sg/hdb-pulse/news/2022/more-support-for-flat-owners-constrained-by-the-ethnic-inegration-policy](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/hdb-pulse/news/2022/more-support-for-flat-owners-constrained-by-the-ethnic-inegration-policy)).
- The period over which a flat owner has marketed the flat must be comparable to the time taken by most flat owners to sell their flats, which HDB presently considers to be six months based on its experience, though this may change depending on prevailing market conditions ([https://www.hdb.gov.sg/hdb-pulse/news/2022/more-support-for-flat-owners-constrained-by-the-ethnic-inegration-policy](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/hdb-pulse/news/2022/more-support-for-flat-owners-constrained-by-the-ethnic-inegration-policy)).
- To set a reasonable asking price, flat owners can take reference from recent transaction prices for flats located within 200m of their flat and make adjustments for attributes such as storey height and orientation, using details published via HDB's Transactions Within 200 Metres e-Service ([https://www.hdb.gov.sg/hdb-pulse/news/2022/more-support-for-flat-owners-constrained-by-the-ethnic-inegration-policy](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/hdb-pulse/news/2022/more-support-for-flat-owners-constrained-by-the-ethnic-inegration-policy)).
- Flat owners should keep monthly records of their marketing attempts throughout the marketing period (such as online or print property listings including asking price and listing date, and records of flat viewings) to submit to HDB when seeking assistance ([https://www.hdb.gov.sg/hdb-pulse/news/2022/more-support-for-flat-owners-constrained-by-the-ethnic-inegration-policy](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/hdb-pulse/news/2022/more-support-for-flat-owners-constrained-by-the-ethnic-inegration-policy)).
- EIP-constrained flat owners who do not fulfil these criteria but face extenuating circumstances may seek special consideration from HDB ([https://www.hdb.gov.sg/hdb-pulse/news/2022/more-support-for-flat-owners-constrained-by-the-ethnic-inegration-policy](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/hdb-pulse/news/2022/more-support-for-flat-owners-constrained-by-the-ethnic-inegration-policy)).
- Eligible flat owners include both those who bought their flats from HDB and those who purchased their flats on the resale market, regardless of whether the flat was EIP-constrained when it was bought ([https://www.hdb.gov.sg/hdb-pulse/news/2022/more-support-for-flat-owners-constrained-by-the-ethnic-inegration-policy](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/hdb-pulse/news/2022/more-support-for-flat-owners-constrained-by-the-ethnic-inegration-policy)).
